correctness.rationale: Finite-field Gauss summation gives |S_r|=q²+εq and isotropic dual-level count q². Fourier inversion in b proves the exact Salié identity Σ_{t≠0}η(t)ψ(at+b/t)=η(a)GΣ_{v²=4ab}ψ(v). Completing quadratic squares yields F_r(ξ≠0)=qεΣ_{v²=rQ*(ξ)}ψ(v). For nonsquare level the sum vanishes; for square level it is a pair of cosines, never zero in odd characteristic. Multiplicities and the trace fiber sum give ||P||_{1→1}=||P||_{∞→∞}=(q+ε)C_p/p+(1−ε)/q−(1−ε)/q²; point masses and sign-alignment attain the two endpoint operator norms. Traceless Hermitian 2x2 idempotents are the ε=−1 nonzero shell, and the extra scalar axis repeats each kernel coefficient q times. Independent complete direct DFT enumeration at q=3,5,7 over prime fields for both ε sectors agreed to floating tolerance with exact shell and Fourier-zero counts, including q=3 values 16/9 and 8/3; no inference from finite data to all q.
